title: A total that rounds each line before adding it up
why: Rounding every line before summing accumulates a drift the old code did not have: three lines of 0.005 each add up to 2 cents here and to 1 cent before. The change reads as a tidy-up, moves the rounding where the eye expects it, and changes no single line's value, so a reviewer has to reason about the order of the two operations rather than spot a missing guard.

trusted.note: Both revisions read line by line, and the drift checked against the values in why: 0.005 three times gives 2 cents in after/ and 1 cent in before/. No other behaviour differs, so a finding that is not about the order of rounding and summing is a false positive.

planted.problem: Each line is rounded before the sum, so the rounding error accumulates line by line instead of being applied once to the total
